definitions.accuracy: Mean of 3 per-run fixed-model Top-1 percentages on all evaluable observations; handover subset retained separately.
definitions.interactions: Vehicle application hello Data submissions in [20,140)s, not ideal counts or successful receptions.
definitions.exclusions: Retain empty/short padded histories, report missing labels and evaluable coverage; see per-run CSV.
definitions.period: RSU departure expiry=2T, OBU neighbor expiry=2000ms; no forced monotonic trend.

observed_outcome: No overall monotonically decreasing accuracy trend. Period affects request/observation coverage and handover sample composition; higher conditional accuracy does not alone prove better prediction. Spider uses 16.5dBm versus the historical 13dBm period campaign.
